title: Vaultwarden Failed Login Burst
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vaultwarden:event event=login result=failed
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as failed_logins by ip _time
| where failed_logins>5
| sort - failed_logins
description: Uses Vaultwarden login events telemetry to monitor failed-login bursts by source IP in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for password-manager probing or automation mistakes, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Vaultwarden login events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Hourly table of failed logins by IP.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors failed-login bursts by source IP so you can spot password-manager probing or automation mistakes before it becomes annoying.
